product_summary: Website grandasiaexports.com (Roorkee, Uttarakhand; 29 Bhagirathi Kunj, Station Road, Roorkee 247667) presents itself as a bulk exporter of whole and ground Indian spices: whole black pepper, whole cinnamon, whole small cardamom, whole clove, whole cumin seeds, ground turmeric powder, ground red chilli powder, ground garam masala; site states '25 spices and pulses' in two ranges (whole / ground). No rice line visible on the homepage; no pulses named individually.
comment: Declared 091099 (other spices, nes) is broadly consistent with the spice range but is a residual code: the named products map to 090411 (pepper), 090611 (cinnamon), 090831 (cardamom), 090710 (cloves), 090931 (cumin seeds), 091030 (turmeric), 090422 (chilli, crushed/ground), 091091 (mixtures such as garam masala). Declared 100630 (semi-milled/wholly milled rice) is NOT corroborated by any product line on the site — the site mentions 'spices and pulses', not rice; rice code should be treated as unverified/possibly erroneous and replaced by the actual spice codes. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a generic misclassification: the actual profile is a spice trader/exporter, not FMCG. Trader signs: no manufacturing plant, no processing capacity or factory address stated; positioning is 'sourced directly from trusted farmers', cleaning/sorting/packing only, bulk wholesale to importers and distributors — consistent with a trading/aggregation role rather than a manufacturer. All product claims (SGS certification, D-U-N-S, FIEO membership, export to US/Canada/Australia/Europe/Africa/Middle East, testimonials) are website self-declarations only — заявлено, не подтверждено; no customs line, B/L or shipment record was reviewed in this HS-only scope. Product sub-pages (/products, /shop, sitemap) returned 404, so the full 25-item list could not be enumerated; codes above cover only the products named on the homepage. No registry, revenue or volume data researched per scope.
